title: semantic-abi manifest (v0-draft)
description: Declares what a component's evidence is allowed to mean. NOT YET FROZEN — see manifest-v0.md.

author.description: owner handle — adapters are authored independently

authorityClass.description: v0-draft open enum — to be frozen as a closed set

evidenceType.description: Authority never transfers on class alone — only for the SAME claim at the SAME scope.

establishes.description: the ONE evidence type this endpoint genuinely creates (authority_class + claim_type + scope)

does_not_establish.description: authority classes explicitly disclaimed — this field is what makes a TYPE ERROR possible

oneOf.description: a component that ORIGINATES a claim carries issued_at

issued_at.description: when this component made its own claim

oneOf.description: a component whose job is CHECKING someone else's claim carries verification_time

verification_time.description: when this check ran (distinct from the checked claim's issued_at)
